verdict.rationale: Adyen docs describe a standalone terminal option as the 'quickest way to accept in-person payments' and Tap to Pay on iPhone/Android requiring 'no extra hardware,' plus centralized terminal ordering/management via the Customer Area or Management API, all consistent with fast reader setup. However there's no first-party or independent walkthrough showing an actual pairing/registration-to-first-payment flow in minutes, and one community account describes a painful, hundreds-of-hours integration experience with Adyen's card-present/POS architecture, undercutting the 'quick' framing for full API integrations (though that complaint is more about developer integration than device pairing). Missing for 10: a concrete step-by-step pairing/registration walkthrough or independent hands-on account confirming the 'minutes' timeframe, and resolution of the integration-friction concern raised in community evidence.
